title: 021 — Refund enquiry following a carrier investigation

plan.situation: Iona Fen's parcel VEL-021-26 from Marigold Books has had no scan since 2026-10-12 18:20 BST at Cress depot. Vellora opened trace TR-021 at 08:00 BST on 14 Oct. Its status is open, with no finding yet and the next review at 12:00 BST on 15 Oct. Ms Fen thinks the open investigation means the parcel is confirmed lost. She wants that confirmed and her GBP 39 refunded today. Marigold has made no refund decision and given no payment authorisation.

facts.fact: VEL-021-26 for Iona Fen from Marigold Books has no recent delivery scan

Under RM21, opening a carrier investigation is not a finding of loss. Merchant care decides refunds from the actual carrier result or a documented discretionary decision. Escalation staff cannot promise payment
Trace TR-021 was opened 2026-10-14T08:00+01:00. Status open, finding null, next review 2026-10-15T12:00+01:00
Customer says the investigation means loss is confirmed and asks for a GBP 39 refund
No refund decision or payment authorisation exists on the merchant account
Last physical scan was 2026-10-12T18:20+01:00 at Cress depot
Customer asks for loss to be confirmed and money sent today

conflicts: Customer says loss is confirmed (E04/E06). The record shows TR-021 is open with no finding (E03), and RM21 says opening an investigation is not a loss finding (E02). The record settles this; nothing needs brokering.
missing_information: Carrier investigation finding for TR-021 (due for review 2026-10-15 12:00 BST)
Marigold Books merchant care refund decision, which depends on that finding or a documented discretionary decision

authority_map.controls: Investigation TR-021 and any loss finding; next review 2026-10-15 12:00 BST
Refund decision, based on the carrier result or a documented discretionary decision

plan.decision_summary: Decline to confirm loss or promise a refund today. Tell Ms Fen that TR-021 is open with no finding, that the next carrier review is at 12:00 BST on 15 Oct, and that Marigold Books merchant care decides any refund after that. Set a follow-up for the review time.
plan.rationale: Under RM21, opening an investigation is not a loss finding, and escalation staff cannot promise payment. The finding is null and the merchant has given no authorisation. The carrier's review time is still ahead, so chasing now adds nothing. The customer has not been answered yet, so she should get an accurate explanation and a concrete next step.

actions.subject: VEL-021-26 – update on your parcel investigation
actions.purpose: Correct the idea that loss is confirmed, decline the request for payment today, and give the real next step
actions.body:
Dear Ms Fen,

Thank you for your messages about parcel VEL-021-26 from Marigold Books.

I'm sorry, but I can't confirm that your parcel is lost, and I can't arrange a refund today. Opening an investigation doesn't mean the parcel has been found to be lost. It means our trace team is now looking for it. The investigation (reference TR-021) was opened at 08:00 BST on 14 October. It is still open and has no result yet. Our records show the parcel was last scanned at our Cress depot at 18:20 BST on 12 October.

The trace team's next review is due at 12:00 BST on 15 October. Refunds are decided by Marigold Books customer care, not by us. They make that decision based on the investigation result. I'll check the investigation at that time and write to you with whatever it shows. No action is needed from you now.

Please note this message is an update, not a confirmation of loss or of any refund.

Kind regards,
Rivet Delivery Desk

actions.body: Check the TR-021 status and finding with trace@vellora.example. If there is a finding, send it to Marigold Books merchant care (care@marigold.example) for a refund decision and update Iona Fen. If there is still no finding, ask the trace team for the next review time. If the parcel is still unscanned, consider moving the case to investigations.

actions.purpose: Record the decision and the reason
actions.body: Customer asked for loss confirmation and a GBP 39 refund today. Declined under RM21 (E02): TR-021 is open with no finding (E03), and there is no merchant refund decision or authorisation (E05). Customer has been told the next review is 2026-10-15 12:00 BST and that merchant care decides refunds. Follow-up set for that time.

Not promising or giving a time for any refund: only Marigold merchant care can decide this, and no authorisation exists
Not chasing trace now: the carrier's review time is still ahead
Not asking merchant care for a discretionary refund: nothing in the record supports going around the carrier's result
Not sending payment links or asking for bank details
plan.follow_up: At 2026-10-15 12:00 BST, check the TR-021 finding with trace@vellora.example. If there is a finding, pass it to care@marigold.example for a refund decision and update the customer. If there is still no finding, ask the trace team for a new review time and consider moving the case to investigations.

review_rounds.plan_summary: Decline to confirm loss or promise a refund today. Tell Ms Fen that TR-021 is open with no finding, that the next carrier review is at 12:00 BST on 15 Oct, and that Marigold Books merchant care decides any refund after that. Set a follow-up for the review time.

issues.problem: The message is signed 'Rivet Delivery Desk', but the case record names the desk as the Vellora escalation desk.
issues.fix: Sign the message with the desk name used in the record, for example 'Vellora escalation desk'.

issues.problem: The action_class is 'ask_customer', but the message asks the customer for nothing. It explains and declines her request.
issues.fix: Change the action_class to an inform or decline class.

issues.problem: The message says merchant care decides refunds 'based on the investigation result'. Under RM21, merchant care can also make a documented discretionary decision.
issues.fix: Optionally say the decision is based on the investigation result 'or its own review'. Do not imply that a discretionary refund is likely.

review.summary: The plan is sound and can go ahead; the three issues are minor fixes. The desk has not yet replied to the customer, so a first reply is the right next step. The reply correctly declines to confirm loss or promise a refund, as RM21 requires: the trace has no finding yet and Marigold has not authorised any refund. It gives the carrier's real review time (12:00 BST on 15 October), names Marigold Books as the party that decides refunds, and sets a follow-up for the review time.
